In Secure, merch cards are recorded with the Gift Card tender and the receipt shows Gift Card Redemption even when a merch card was issued.

PacSun LP would like to flag three scenarios:

1. Merch cards issued on non receipted returns.
2. Merch cards issued on returns where the original sale was paid by credit or debit card, instead of refunding the original tender.
3. The same non transferable merch card used under different customer names.
